name: All Interfaces (e2e)
description: Schema-9 protocol covering all 20 interface types, used by the Architect e2e suite.

title.en-US: This interview uses enhanced privacy protection

body.en-US: This interview allows you to encrypt the names of people you mention so they cannot be seen by anyone but you. To use this feature, enter a passphrase below.

text.en-US: There are a few questions about you before we begin.
Who are the people you know?
Place the people who know each other close together
Highlight the people you feel closest to
This section will go through all possible node pairs and ask you how they are connected.
Do these two people know each other?
Tap on all the people who this person knows
This interface both creates an edge and assigns an ordinal value to it.
How close are these two people?
How often do you have contact with this person?
What type of contact do you have most with this person?

prompt.en-US: What is this person's relationship to you?
Does this person have this attribute?

text.en-US: A few more questions about each person.

finishConfirmation.en-US: Are you sure you want to finish the interview?

finishedNotice.en-US: This interview is finished, and its answers can no longer be changed.

finishFailed.en-US: The interview could not be finished. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the study organizer.

content.en-US: You have reached the end of the interview. If you are satisfied with the information you have entered, you may finish the interview now.

exitInterviewDescription.en-US: Your answers so far will be saved and you can continue later.

stageError.en-US: There was an error with the interview software, and this task could not be displayed. Some tasks, such as maps, need an internet connection, so check your connection and then try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, please contact the study organizer and send them the debug information, which you can copy with the button below. You may be able to continue your interview by clicking the next button.

itemUnavailable.en-US: This item could not be displayed.

choosePassphraseHelp.en-US: Some answers on this screen are protected by a passphrase. Keep it safe: you will need it to see or change these answers later, and it cannot be recovered if it is forgotten.

passphraseIncorrect.en-US: This passphrase does not match the one used earlier in this interview. Check it and try again.

protectedAnswersLocked.en-US: Some answers here are protected by your passphrase. Enter your passphrase to see and change them.

protectedAnswersNotSaved.en-US: Your answers have not been saved. Enter your passphrase, then try again.

protectedAnswersUnavailable.en-US: Answers protected by a passphrase cannot be shown or saved in this interview. Please let the person who recruited you to this study know.

answerUnavailableKept.en-US: This answer was saved earlier but cannot be shown here. Entering a new answer will replace it, so leave the field empty to keep the earlier answer.

discardChangesDescription.en-US: This form contains invalid data, so it cannot be saved. If you continue it will be reset, and your changes will be lost. Do you want to discard your changes?

submitFailed.en-US: An error occurred while submitting the form.
